name: emr

machine_peak.mem_bw_derivation: 8 channels x DDR5-5600 MT/s x 8 B = 358.4 GB/s per socket (ONE NUMA domain, SNC off). Datasheet theoretical peak.
machine_peak.amx_bf16_derivation: 64 cores x 1024 bf16 FLOP/cyc/core (AMX TMUL 16x16x32 = 16384 FLOP / 16 cyc) x 2.9 GHz AMX all-core = 190.1 TFLOP/s. Theoretical UPPER BOUND; set amx_bf16_ghz_allcore to 1.9 (base->124.6) or 2.3 (->150.7) for a lower machine-peak assumption.
machine_peak.note: ROOFLINE CEILING for Phase A = these machine-peak numbers. Measured-achievable (mem_bw_gbps=214.4, amx_bf16_tflops=40.3) is the reference FLOOR = where we are today; the gap to machine peak is the optimization headroom. Exercise all levers toward machine peak; when an op plateaus below it, SURFACE the residual gap and STOP.

measured_how: MEASURED 2026-10-07 uarch_probe_verify.py on pcl-spr10, numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0, 64 threads (ONE socket = ONE NUMA domain, SNC off). BW=214.4 GB/s (stream-triad fp32 2GB). AMX bf16=40.3 TFLOP/s = torch.matmul plateau at 16384^3 (size-dependent: 13.5@2048, 26@4096, 32.5@8192, 40.3@16384; still climbing) ~= 32pct of theoretical ~124-190 TFLOP/s -> CONSERVATIVE achievable peak; hand-tuned brgemm could exceed. These measured values are the REFERENCE FLOOR; the Phase-A roofline ceiling is machine_peak (above). Decode is BW-bound across M{1..64} regardless of exact compute peak; AMX peak governs only compute-bound attention + prefill.
